头.gloss: noun suffix used after some nouns (as in stone, wood, tongue)

example.zh: 院子里有一块大石头，孩子们喜欢坐在上面玩。
example.en: There's a big stone in the yard, and the kids like to sit on it and play.

quiz.zh: 这张桌子是用木头做的，摸起来很结实。
quiz.en: This table is made of wood and feels very solid.

example.zh: 如有任何疑问，请随时与我们联系。
example.en: If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.

quiz.zh: 这里的风景美丽如画，每年都吸引很多游客。
quiz.en: The scenery here is as beautiful as a painting and attracts many tourists every year.

example.zh: 他和我同岁，可是看起来比我大好几岁。
example.en: He and I are the same age, but he looks several years older than me.

quiz.zh: 这件事我同你说过好几次了，你怎么还忘了？
quiz.en: I've told you about this several times; how could you still forget?

example.zh: 没想到这次考试竟然如此简单，大家都很快交了卷。
example.en: Nobody expected the exam to be so easy; everyone handed in their papers quickly.

quiz.zh: 他每天都练习到深夜，正因为如此，他才取得了今天的成绩。
quiz.en: He practises late into the night every day; it's precisely because of this that he has achieved what he has today.

处.gloss: to get along with, to handle; place, location

example.zh: 他脾气好，跟邻居们一直处得很好。
example.en: He's good-natured and has always got along well with his neighbours.

quiz.zh: 山上有一处温泉，冬天去泡最舒服了。
quiz.en: There's a hot spring up on the mountain; soaking in it in winter is the best.

example.zh: 这家公司的产品质量好，其价格也比较合理。
example.en: This company's products are of good quality, and their prices are also fairly reasonable.

quiz.zh: 这本书很受欢迎，其作者是一位年轻的大学老师。
quiz.en: This book is very popular; its author is a young university teacher.

example.zh: 我曾在北京工作过三年，对那里很熟悉。
example.en: I once worked in Beijing for three years, so I know it well.

quiz.zh: 这位老人年轻时曾当过兵，至今还保持着早起的习惯。
quiz.en: This old man once served in the army when he was young and still keeps the habit of getting up early.

example.zh: 解决这个问题，我们要考虑经济和环境两个方面。
example.en: To solve this problem, we need to consider both the economic and environmental aspects.

quiz.zh: 这张纸正反两面都写满了字，一点空白都没有。
quiz.en: Both sides of this sheet of paper are covered in writing, with no blank space at all.

超.gloss: to exceed, to surpass, to go over

example.zh: 这条路限速六十公里，他开到了九十，严重超速了。
example.en: The speed limit on this road is 60 km/h; he was doing 90, seriously speeding.

quiz.zh: 你的行李超重了五公斤，需要另外付费。
quiz.en: Your luggage is five kilos overweight, so you need to pay an extra fee.

example.zh: 会议讨论了教育、医疗及住房等问题。
example.en: The meeting discussed issues such as education, healthcare and housing.

quiz.zh: 请把你的姓名、电话及地址写在这张表上。
quiz.en: Please write your name, phone number and address on this form.

伤.gloss: injury, wound; to injure, to hurt

example.zh: 他在比赛中伤了腿，只好提前下场。
example.en: He hurt his leg during the match and had to leave the field early.

quiz.zh: 医生说他的伤不严重，休息一周就能好。
quiz.en: The doctor said his injury isn't serious and will heal after a week of rest.

眼.gloss: eye; measure word for wells, glances
眼.indonesian: mata; kata penggolong untuk sumur, lirikan

example.zh: 她看了我一眼，什么也没说就走了。
example.en: She glanced at me and left without saying anything.

quiz.zh: 村子中间有一眼老井，至今还有清水。
quiz.en: In the middle of the village there is an old well that still has clear water.

令.gloss: to order, to command; order, command

example.zh: 教练一声令下，队员们立刻冲了出去。
example.en: At the coach's command, the players dashed out at once.

quiz.zh: 警方已下令关闭这条道路，直到事故处理完毕。
quiz.en: The police have ordered the road closed until the accident has been dealt with.

力.gloss: strength, power, force; suffix for ability or force
力.indonesian: tenaga, kekuatan; akhiran untuk kemampuan atau daya

example.zh: 他用力推开了那扇沉重的门。
example.en: He pushed open the heavy door with force.

quiz.zh: 学外语需要很强的记忆力和耐心。
quiz.en: Learning a foreign language requires a strong memory and patience.

随.gloss: to follow, to go along with

example.zh: 你随我来，我带你去看看新办公室。
example.en: Come with me; I'll show you the new office.

quiz.zh: 游客们随导游走进了古老的寺庙。
quiz.en: The tourists followed the guide into the ancient temple.

度.gloss: degree (of temperature, angle, etc.); measure word for occurrences, times
度.indonesian: derajat; kata penggolong untuk kali, kejadian

example.zh: 今天最高气温三十五度，出门记得带水。
example.en: Today's high is 35 degrees, so remember to bring water when you go out.

quiz.zh: 这位导演曾两度获得最佳导演奖。
quiz.en: This director has twice won the Best Director award.

单.gloss: single, alone; bill, list (as in menu, receipt)
单.indonesian: tunggal, sendiri; daftar, tagihan (seperti menu, struk)

example.zh: 服务员，请把菜单拿给我看一下。
example.en: Waiter, could you bring me the menu, please?

quiz.zh: 这次吃饭我来买单，你们谁都别跟我抢。
quiz.en: I'm paying the bill for this meal; don't anyone try to beat me to it.

至.gloss: to arrive, to reach; to, until

example.zh: 营业时间为上午九点至晚上十点。
example.en: Business hours are from 9 a.m. to 10 p.m.

quiz.zh: 这条高速公路从广州至深圳全长约一百公里。
quiz.en: This expressway runs from Guangzhou to Shenzhen, about 100 kilometres in total.

example.zh: 新政策让人民的生活水平有了明显提高。
example.en: The new policy has clearly raised the people's standard of living.

quiz.zh: 他一生都在为国家和人民服务，深受大家尊敬。
quiz.en: He spent his whole life serving his country and the people, and is deeply respected.

example.zh: 据天气预报说，明天会有大雨。
example.en: According to the weather forecast, there will be heavy rain tomorrow.

quiz.zh: 据统计，今年来这里旅游的人比去年多了一倍。
quiz.en: According to statistics, the number of visitors here this year is double last year's.

亲.gloss: close, dear, related by blood; to kiss

example.zh: 妈妈亲了亲孩子的脸，笑着说晚安。
example.en: Mum kissed the child's cheek and said good night with a smile.

quiz.zh: 她是我的亲姐姐，我们从小一起长大。
quiz.en: She's my own (biological) older sister; we grew up together.

投.gloss: to throw, to cast; to put in

example.zh: 他把球投进了篮筐，全场观众欢呼起来。
example.en: He threw the ball into the basket and the whole crowd cheered.

quiz.zh: 很多人往许愿池里投硬币，希望愿望成真。
quiz.en: Many people throw coins into the wishing pool, hoping their wishes will come true.

example.zh: 这件衣服原价五百，现在只卖两百。
example.en: This piece of clothing was originally 500, and now it's only 200.

quiz.zh: 他从原单位辞职后，开了一家自己的公司。
quiz.en: After resigning from his former employer, he started his own company.

集.gloss: collection, volume; measure word for episodes
集.indonesian: kumpulan, jilid; kata penggolong untuk episode

example.zh: 这部电视剧一共有四十集，我两周就看完了。
example.en: This TV series has forty episodes in total, and I finished it in two weeks.

quiz.zh: 昨天晚上那一集特别精彩，你看了吗？
quiz.en: Last night's episode was especially great. Did you watch it?

example.zh: 他在公司里有钱有权，说话很有分量。
example.en: He has money and power in the company, so his words carry a lot of weight.

quiz.zh: 这件事我无权做主，你还是去问问经理吧。
quiz.en: I have no authority to decide this; you'd better ask the manager.

反.gloss: opposite, reversed; to oppose; on the contrary

example.zh: 他把衣服穿反了，自己还不知道。
example.en: He put his clothes on inside out and didn't even know it.

quiz.zh: 吃了药以后，他的病不但没好，反而更重了。
quiz.en: After taking the medicine, his illness didn't get better; on the contrary, it got worse.

example.zh: 这个消息很快就在学校里传开了。
example.en: The news quickly spread throughout the school.

quiz.zh: 请把这些试卷传给后面的同学。
quiz.en: Please pass these test papers back to the classmates behind you.

怪.gloss: strange, odd; to blame; quite, rather

example.zh: 这件事不能怪他，是我没有说清楚。
example.en: You can't blame him for this; I didn't explain it clearly.

quiz.zh: 这个人真怪，大热天还穿着厚外套。
quiz.en: This guy is really strange, wearing a thick coat on such a hot day.

example.zh: 她经常在网上分享自己做的菜。
example.en: She often shares the dishes she cooks online.

quiz.zh: 我想跟大家分享一个好消息：我们的项目成功了！
quiz.en: I'd like to share some good news with everyone: our project succeeded!

架.gloss: shelf, frame, rack; measure word for planes, machines
架.indonesian: rak, rangka; kata penggolong untuk pesawat, mesin

example.zh: 一架飞机从我们头顶飞过，声音特别大。
example.en: A plane flew over our heads, really loudly.

quiz.zh: 他把看完的书都整齐地放回了书架上。
quiz.en: He put all the books he had finished neatly back on the bookshelf.

example.zh: 新软件上线前，需要经过多次测试。
example.en: New software has to go through many rounds of testing before it goes live.

quiz.zh: 老师下周要测试一下大家的听力水平。
quiz.en: Next week the teacher is going to test everyone's listening level.

级.gloss: level, grade, rank; measure word for steps, stairs
级.indonesian: tingkat, kelas; kata penggolong untuk anak tangga

example.zh: 我弟弟今年上小学三年级，学习很认真。
example.en: My younger brother is in the third grade of primary school this year and studies hard.

quiz.zh: 这座塔一共有三百多级台阶，爬上去要半个小时。
quiz.en: This tower has more than three hundred steps; it takes half an hour to climb up.

代.gloss: to represent, to act on behalf of; generation

example.zh: 我们这一代人跟父母那一代人的想法很不一样。
example.en: Our generation thinks very differently from our parents' generation.

quiz.zh: 请代我向你父母问好，祝他们身体健康。
quiz.en: Please say hello to your parents for me and wish them good health.

example.zh: 我更喜欢中式早餐，比如包子和豆浆。
example.en: I prefer a Chinese-style breakfast, like steamed buns and soy milk.

quiz.zh: 这家餐厅提供正宗的西式牛排。
quiz.en: This restaurant serves authentic Western-style steak.

调.gloss: to transfer, to move (a person); to adjust, to tune

example.zh: 他上个月被调到上海分公司工作了。
example.en: Last month he was transferred to the Shanghai branch.

quiz.zh: 电视声音太大了，把音量调小一点吧。
quiz.en: The TV is too loud; turn the volume down a bit.

example.zh: 是医生及时赶到，才救了他一命。
example.en: It was the doctor arriving in time that saved his life.

quiz.zh: 他总说自己命不好，其实是不够努力。
quiz.en: He always says he was born unlucky, but really he just doesn't work hard enough.

烧.gloss: to burn; to cook, to roast

example.zh: 昨天夜里，一场大火烧掉了整个仓库。
example.en: Last night a big fire burned down the whole warehouse.

quiz.zh: 他不小心把饭烧焦了，厨房里全是糊味。
quiz.en: He accidentally burned the rice, and the whole kitchen smelled scorched.

安.gloss: peaceful, calm, at ease; to calm, to comfort

example.zh: 听到孩子平安到家的消息，妈妈才安下心来。
example.en: Only when she heard that her child had got home safely did the mother's mind settle.

quiz.zh: 考试结果还没出来，他心里一直很不安。
quiz.en: The exam results aren't out yet, and he has been feeling uneasy.

example.zh: 小猫藏在床底下，怎么叫都不出来。
example.en: The kitten is hiding under the bed and won't come out no matter how you call it.

quiz.zh: 他把钱藏在一本旧书里，结果自己也忘了。
quiz.en: He hid the money in an old book and then forgot about it himself.

配.gloss: to match, to go with; to be worthy of, well-matched

example.zh: 这条裙子配白色的鞋子更好看。
example.en: This skirt looks better with white shoes.

quiz.zh: 他觉得自己配不上她，一直不敢表白。
quiz.en: He feels he isn't good enough for her, so he has never dared to confess his feelings.

保.gloss: to protect, to keep, to safeguard; to guarantee

example.zh: 医生们尽了全力，终于保住了他的腿。
example.en: The doctors did everything they could and finally saved his leg.

quiz.zh: 为了保住这份工作，他每天都加班到很晚。
quiz.en: To keep this job, he works overtime until late every day.

抽.gloss: to take out, to pull out; to smoke

example.zh: 他从书包里抽出一本书递给我。
example.en: He pulled a book out of his schoolbag and handed it to me.

quiz.zh: 这里是公共场所，请不要抽烟。
quiz.en: This is a public place; please don't smoke.

example.zh: 本次活动需提前报名，名额有限。
example.en: You need to register in advance for this event; places are limited.

quiz.zh: 办理护照需带上身份证和照片。
quiz.en: To apply for a passport you need to bring your ID card and photos.

合.gloss: to close, to shut; to fit, to suit; to join

example.zh: 他累坏了，刚合上书就趴在桌上睡着了。
example.en: He was exhausted; the moment he closed the book he fell asleep on the desk.

quiz.zh: 收到录取通知书，他笑得合不拢嘴。
quiz.en: When he received the acceptance letter, he couldn't stop grinning.

胜.gloss: to win, to defeat, to beat

example.zh: 昨晚的比赛，我们队以三比一胜了对手。
example.en: In last night's game, our team beat the opponents 3 to 1.

quiz.zh: 这场比赛谁胜谁负，现在还很难说。
quiz.en: It's still hard to say who will win and who will lose this match.

建.gloss: to build, to construct; to establish

example.zh: 这座石桥是一百多年前建的，现在还很结实。
example.en: This stone bridge was built more than a hundred years ago and is still very solid.

quiz.zh: 学校旁边正在建一座新的图书馆。
quiz.en: A new library is being built next to the school.

example.zh: 别担心，我们准备的食物足够大家吃三天。
example.en: Don't worry, the food we've prepared is enough for everyone for three days.

quiz.zh: 只要给我足够的时间，我一定能把这件事做好。
quiz.en: As long as you give me enough time, I'll definitely get this done well.

拍摄.gloss: to shoot, to film (a photo or film)

example.zh: 这部电影是在云南拍摄的，风景特别美。
example.en: This film was shot in Yunnan, and the scenery is gorgeous.

quiz.zh: 博物馆里禁止拍摄，请大家把相机收起来。
quiz.en: Filming and photography are forbidden in the museum; please put your cameras away.

愿.gloss: to wish, to hope; to be willing

example.zh: 他说他愿为这个项目付出一切。
example.en: He said he was willing to give everything for this project.

quiz.zh: 但愿明天天气好，我们就可以去爬山了。
quiz.en: Let's hope the weather is good tomorrow so we can go hiking.

example.zh: 这个消息太突然了，让人难以相信。
example.en: The news was so sudden that it was hard to believe.

quiz.zh: 那次旅行的经历让我至今难以忘记。
quiz.en: I still find that trip hard to forget, even now.

运.gloss: to transport, to ship, to carry

example.zh: 工人们正在把家具运到楼上。
example.en: The workers are carrying the furniture upstairs.

quiz.zh: 这些水果要用冷藏车运到北京。
quiz.en: This fruit has to be shipped to Beijing in refrigerated trucks.

example.zh: 这座古城具有两千多年的历史。
example.en: This ancient city has a history of more than two thousand years.

quiz.zh: 这种植物具有很高的药用价值。
quiz.en: This plant has high medicinal value.

example.zh: 这个小镇的医疗条件比以前好多了。
example.en: Medical care in this small town is much better than before.

quiz.zh: 政府加大了对农村医疗的投入，看病越来越方便了。
quiz.en: The government has increased investment in rural healthcare, and seeing a doctor is getting easier.

example.zh: 爷爷最喜欢看京剧，每周都去戏院。
example.en: Grandpa loves Beijing opera and goes to the theatre every week.

quiz.zh: 这出戏讲的是一个古代爱情故事。
quiz.en: This play tells an ancient love story.

处于.gloss: to be in (a state, stage or position)

example.zh: 这家公司目前正处于快速发展阶段。
example.en: This company is currently in a stage of rapid growth.

quiz.zh: 病人仍处于危险期，需要继续观察。
quiz.en: The patient is still in a critical condition and needs further observation.

example.zh: 只有国家强大了，人民才能过上好日子。
example.en: Only when the country is strong can the people live a good life.

quiz.zh: 这台电脑功能强大，运行速度也很快。
quiz.en: This computer is powerful and also runs very fast.

替.gloss: to replace, to take the place of; for, on behalf of

example.zh: 我今天不舒服，你能替我去开会吗？
example.en: I'm not feeling well today. Could you go to the meeting for me?

quiz.zh: 听说你考上了大学，我真替你高兴！
quiz.en: I heard you got into university. I'm so happy for you!

example.zh: 春天是去那里旅游的最佳季节。
example.en: Spring is the best season to travel there.

quiz.zh: 她凭这部电影获得了最佳女演员奖。
quiz.en: She won the Best Actress award for this film.

初.gloss: beginning, early part; for the first time; first (prefix)

example.zh: 我们打算下个月初去海南旅行，机票已经订好了。
example.en: We plan to travel to Hainan at the beginning of next month, and the flights are already booked.

quiz.zh: 他初来这座城市时，一个朋友都没有。
quiz.en: When he first came to this city, he didn't have a single friend.

example.zh: 他为了赚钱不择手段，最后被抓了。
example.en: He used any means to make money and was eventually arrested.

quiz.zh: 价格战是很多商家吸引顾客的常用手段。
quiz.en: A price war is a common tactic many businesses use to attract customers.

example.zh: 这孩子是全家人的宝，大家都特别疼他。
example.en: This child is the whole family's treasure; everyone dotes on him.

quiz.zh: 在奶奶眼里，这些旧家具都是宝，一件也舍不得扔。
quiz.en: In Grandma's eyes, this old furniture is all treasure; she can't bear to throw away a single piece.

贴.gloss: to paste, to stick, to glue

example.zh: 过年的时候，家家户户都在门上贴春联。
example.en: At Chinese New Year, every household pastes spring couplets on their doors.

quiz.zh: 请把照片贴在报名表的右上角。
quiz.en: Please stick your photo in the top right-hand corner of the application form.

example.zh: 这种药物有一定的副作用，必须按医生说的吃。
example.en: This medication has some side effects, so it must be taken as the doctor instructs.

quiz.zh: 有些药物不能和酒一起服用。
quiz.en: Some medications shouldn't be taken with alcohol.

example.zh: 会谈结束后，双方同意进一步加强经济合作。
example.en: After the talks, both sides agreed to further strengthen economic cooperation.

quiz.zh: 警方正在对事故原因进行进一步调查。
quiz.en: The police are carrying out a further investigation into the cause of the accident.

example.zh: 这种外套不但保暖，还能防水。
example.en: This jacket is not only warm but also waterproof.

quiz.zh: 晚上出门要注意安全，特别要防小偷。
quiz.en: Be careful when you go out at night, and especially watch out for thieves.

example.zh: 她第一次站上舞台，紧张得说不出话来。
example.en: The first time she stood on stage, she was so nervous she couldn't speak.

quiz.zh: 演出结束后，演员们一起走到舞台前向观众鞠躬。
quiz.en: After the show, the actors came to the front of the stage together and bowed to the audience.

example.zh: 这些年，这座小城正在快速走向现代化。
example.en: In recent years, this small city has been rapidly modernizing.

quiz.zh: 随着全球化的发展，各国之间的联系越来越紧密。
quiz.en: With the development of globalization, ties between countries are becoming ever closer.

领.gloss: to lead, to take (someone somewhere); collar

example.zh: 导游领着我们参观了整个古城。
example.en: The tour guide led us around the whole ancient city.

quiz.zh: 你的衬衫领子脏了，换一件吧。
quiz.en: Your shirt collar is dirty; put on another one.

结.gloss: to tie, to knot; knot; result

example.zh: 一只蜘蛛在窗户角上结了一张网。
example.en: A spider has spun a web in the corner of the window.

quiz.zh: 鞋带打了个死结，我怎么也解不开。
quiz.en: My shoelace has got into a tight knot, and I just can't undo it.

example.zh: 校长在毕业典礼上发表了讲话。
example.en: The principal gave a speech at the graduation ceremony.

quiz.zh: 他的讲话很简短，但给大家留下了深刻的印象。
quiz.en: His speech was short, but it left a deep impression on everyone.

付出.gloss: to pay, to give, to devote (effort, a price)

example.zh: 为了这次比赛，他付出了很多努力。
example.en: He put a lot of effort into this competition.

quiz.zh: 父母为我们付出了那么多，我们应该好好孝顺他们。
quiz.en: Our parents have given so much for us; we should take good care of them.

example.zh: 明天就要面试了，祝你好运，一切顺利！
example.en: Your interview is tomorrow. Good luck, and I hope it all goes well!

quiz.zh: 他觉得这枚硬币能给他带来好运，一直放在钱包里。
quiz.en: He believes this coin brings him good luck, so he always keeps it in his wallet.

治.gloss: to treat, to cure; to govern, to manage

example.zh: 这家医院专门治眼病，很多外地人也来这里看病。
example.en: This hospital specializes in treating eye diseases, and many people from other places come here for treatment.

quiz.zh: 医生说他的病能治好，让他别太担心。
quiz.en: The doctor said his illness can be cured and told him not to worry too much.

迷.gloss: to be fascinated by, to be crazy about; fan

example.zh: 他最近迷上了钓鱼，每个周末都去河边。
example.en: He's recently become hooked on fishing and goes to the river every weekend.

quiz.zh: 这孩子一玩起游戏就着迷，叫他吃饭都听不见。
quiz.en: Once this kid starts playing games, he's so absorbed he doesn't even hear you call him for dinner.

example.zh: 最近工作量太大了，我每天都要加班。
example.en: My workload has been too heavy recently; I have to work overtime every day.

quiz.zh: 这种药一次吃的量不能太多。
quiz.en: You mustn't take too large a dose of this medicine at once.

闹.gloss: noisy, lively; to make a noise, to make a fuss

example.zh: 楼下的孩子们一直在闹，吵得我没法睡觉。
example.en: The kids downstairs keep making a racket, so I can't sleep.

quiz.zh: 春节期间，街上到处都很热闹。
quiz.en: During the Spring Festival, the streets are lively everywhere.

example.zh: 这个品牌的衣服质量好，价格也不贵。
example.en: This brand's clothes are good quality and not expensive.

quiz.zh: 很多年轻人买东西时更看重品牌。
quiz.en: When shopping, many young people care more about the brand.

录.gloss: to record (sound or video); to write down

example.zh: 老师讲课的时候，我用手机录了下来。
example.en: I recorded the teacher's lecture on my phone.

quiz.zh: 这段视频是用手机录的，所以不太清楚。
quiz.en: This video was recorded on a phone, so it's not very clear.

example.zh: 生日那天，朋友们给了我一个大大的惊喜。
example.en: On my birthday, my friends gave me a big surprise.

quiz.zh: 打开盒子的那一刻，她脸上露出了惊喜的表情。
quiz.en: The moment she opened the box, a look of delighted surprise appeared on her face.

example.zh: 一名年轻女子在地铁上捡到钱包后交给了警察。
example.en: A young woman found a wallet on the subway and handed it to the police.

quiz.zh: 她在全国女子马拉松比赛中获得了冠军。
quiz.en: She won the national women's marathon.

example.zh: 这座电视塔的高度超过三百米，是本市最高的建筑。
example.en: This TV tower is over three hundred metres tall, the tallest building in the city.

quiz.zh: 领导对这个项目给予了高度重视。
quiz.en: The leadership has given this project a high level of attention.

挑.gloss: to choose, to pick, to select; picky

example.zh: 你帮我挑一件适合参加婚礼的衣服吧。
example.en: Help me pick out something suitable to wear to a wedding.

quiz.zh: 这孩子吃饭太挑了，这也不吃那也不吃。
quiz.en: This child is so picky about food; he won't eat this or that.

example.zh: 我老公做的红烧肉特别好吃，孩子们都爱吃。
example.en: My husband's braised pork is delicious; the kids all love it.

quiz.zh: 她和老公结婚十年了，感情一直很好。
quiz.en: She and her husband have been married for ten years and have always got on well.

背后.gloss: behind, at the back; behind someone's back

example.zh: 我家背后有一座小山，周末我常去爬。
example.en: There's a small hill behind my house, and I often climb it at weekends.

quiz.zh: 有意见可以当面提，不要在背后说别人的坏话。
quiz.en: If you have complaints, raise them to people's faces; don't speak ill of others behind their backs.

example.zh: 在我们班的同学当中，他跑得最快。
example.en: Among the students in our class, he runs the fastest.

quiz.zh: 这几个方案当中，你觉得哪个最好？
quiz.en: Of these plans, which one do you think is best?

example.zh: 一名男子因酒后开车被警察拦了下来。
example.en: A man was stopped by the police for drink-driving.

quiz.zh: 他获得了男子一百米比赛的第一名。
quiz.en: He won first place in the men's 100 metres.

躲.gloss: to hide; to avoid, to dodge

example.zh: 下大雨了，我们赶紧到屋檐下躲一躲。
example.en: It's pouring; let's quickly take shelter under the eaves.

quiz.zh: 他一看到老师就躲开了，好像做了什么坏事。
quiz.en: As soon as he saw the teacher he ducked out of sight, as if he'd done something wrong.

example.zh: 公司每年年底都要召开全体员工大会。
example.en: The company holds an all-staff general meeting at the end of every year.

quiz.zh: 这次大会吸引了来自三十多个国家的代表。
quiz.en: This conference attracted delegates from more than thirty countries.

example.zh: 周末我一般在家看书，或是出去跑步。
example.en: At the weekend I usually read at home or go out for a run.

quiz.zh: 你可以坐地铁去，或是打车去，都很方便。
quiz.en: You can take the subway or a taxi; either is convenient.

拼.gloss: to piece together; to go all out, to work desperately hard

example.zh: 为了买房，他们夫妻俩拼了好几年。
example.en: The couple worked flat out for several years to buy a home.

quiz.zh: 比赛还剩最后五分钟，队员们都在拼命地跑。
quiz.en: With five minutes left in the match, the players were all running as hard as they could.

example.zh: 夏天的傍晚，很多人喜欢在湖边散步。
example.en: On summer evenings, many people like to stroll by the lake.

quiz.zh: 这个湖很深，游泳的时候一定要注意安全。
quiz.en: This lake is very deep, so be careful when you swim.

前往.gloss: to go to, to head for, to leave for

example.zh: 总理将于下周前往欧洲访问。
example.en: The premier will travel to Europe for a visit next week.

quiz.zh: 乘客们请注意，前往上海的航班即将起飞。
quiz.en: Attention passengers: the flight to Shanghai is about to take off.

example.zh: 这首歌曲在年轻人中非常流行。
example.en: This song is very popular among young people.

quiz.zh: 他写的歌曲大多是关于家乡和亲人的。
quiz.en: Most of the songs he writes are about his hometown and his family.

example.zh: 这个项目能成功，靠的是整个团队的努力。
example.en: The project's success came down to the whole team's effort.

quiz.zh: 他很善于和别人合作，有很强的团队精神。
quiz.en: He's good at working with others and has a strong team spirit.

example.zh: 每次出差，他必带一本书在路上看。
example.en: Every time he goes on a business trip, he always brings a book to read on the way.

quiz.zh: 他这么做必有原因，你先别急着批评他。
quiz.en: He must have a reason for doing this, so don't rush to criticize him.

example.zh: 这座古城已经有一千多年的历史了。
example.en: This ancient city has a history of more than a thousand years.

quiz.zh: 爷爷收藏了很多古钱币，每一枚都有自己的故事。
quiz.en: Grandpa has collected many ancient coins, and each one has its own story.

example.zh: 这项工程预计明年年底完工。
example.en: This project is expected to be finished by the end of next year.

quiz.zh: 他大学学的是土木工程，现在在建筑公司工作。
quiz.en: He studied civil engineering at university and now works for a construction company.

example.zh: 外面下大雨，我的衣服全湿了。
example.en: It's pouring outside, and my clothes are soaked.

quiz.zh: 地板刚拖过，还有点湿，小心别滑倒。
quiz.en: The floor has just been mopped and is still a bit wet, so be careful not to slip.

造.gloss: to make, to build, to manufacture

example.zh: 这家工厂专门造汽车零件，产品卖到很多国家。
example.en: This factory specializes in making car parts, which it sells to many countries.

quiz.zh: 这艘船是一百年前造的，现在已经成了博物馆。
quiz.en: This ship was built a hundred years ago and has now become a museum.

前进.gloss: to advance, to go forward, to make progress

example.zh: 虽然困难很多，但我们一定会继续前进。
example.en: Although there are many difficulties, we will certainly keep moving forward.

quiz.zh: 大雾天气里，车辆只能慢慢前进。
quiz.en: In heavy fog, vehicles can only move forward slowly.

example.zh: 我们不应该随便干涉他人的生活。
example.en: We shouldn't casually interfere in other people's lives.

quiz.zh: 在公共场所大声打电话会影响他人。
quiz.en: Talking loudly on the phone in public places disturbs others.

守.gloss: to guard, to watch over; to keep, to observe (rules, time)

example.zh: 他守着生病的妈妈，一夜没睡。
example.en: He watched over his sick mother all night without sleeping.

quiz.zh: 我们约好了时间，你一定要守时。
quiz.en: We've agreed on a time, so you must be punctual.

忍.gloss: to endure, to bear, to put up with

example.zh: 打针的时候，他疼得忍不住哭了起来。
example.en: When he got the injection, it hurt so much he couldn't help crying.

quiz.zh: 邻居天天半夜唱歌，我实在忍不了了。
quiz.en: My neighbour sings in the middle of the night every day; I really can't stand it anymore.

退出.gloss: to withdraw, to quit, to exit, to log out

example.zh: 因为受伤，他不得不退出这次比赛。
example.en: Because of an injury, he had to withdraw from the competition.

quiz.zh: 玩完游戏以后，记得退出账号。
quiz.en: Remember to log out of your account after you finish playing.

example.zh: 新到的货物都先放在仓库里，明天再发出去。
example.en: Newly arrived goods are kept in the warehouse first and shipped out tomorrow.

quiz.zh: 他把车停进了车库，就上楼休息了。
quiz.en: He parked the car in the garage and went upstairs to rest.

齐.gloss: neat, even, uniform; all present, complete; together

example.zh: 人都到齐了，我们开始开会吧。
example.en: Everyone's here, so let's start the meeting.

quiz.zh: 他把书架上的书摆得很整齐。
quiz.en: He arranged the books on the shelf very neatly.

example.zh: 新建的公园给市民提供了一个休闲的好去处。
example.en: The new park gives city residents a good place to relax.

quiz.zh: 很多市民对这项新政策表示支持。
quiz.en: Many residents have expressed support for this new policy.

顺.gloss: to go along, to follow; smooth, favourable; in order

example.zh: 祝你一路顺风，到了以后记得给我打个电话！
example.en: Have a safe journey, and remember to give me a call when you arrive!

quiz.zh: 你顺着这条路一直往前走，就能看到地铁站。
quiz.en: Follow this road straight ahead and you'll see the subway station.

登.gloss: to climb, to ascend; to board; to publish, to register

example.zh: 我们花了五个小时才登上山顶。
example.en: It took us five hours to reach the summit.

quiz.zh: 请乘客们拿好行李，准备登机。
quiz.en: Passengers, please take your luggage and prepare to board.

example.zh: 他在一次车祸中不幸去世了。
example.en: He sadly died in a car accident.

quiz.zh: 听到这个不幸的消息，大家都很难过。
quiz.en: Everyone was very sad to hear the unfortunate news.

上升.gloss: to rise, to go up, to increase

example.zh: 最近几天气温不断上升，已经超过三十五度了。
example.en: Temperatures have kept rising over the last few days and are now above 35 degrees.

quiz.zh: 今年这家公司的销售额上升了百分之二十。
quiz.en: This year the company's sales rose by twenty percent.

example.zh: 下课以后，孩子们围着老师问这问那。
example.en: After class, the children gathered around the teacher, asking all sorts of questions.

quiz.zh: 一群人围在路边，不知道在看什么。
quiz.en: A crowd had gathered at the roadside; I couldn't tell what they were looking at.

example.zh: 我已经在地图上查好了去机场的路线。
example.en: I've already looked up the route to the airport on the map.

quiz.zh: 这条旅游路线经过好几个著名景点。
quiz.en: This tour route passes several famous sights.

example.zh: 这架飞机的飞行速度非常快。
example.en: This plane flies very fast.

quiz.zh: 经过十个小时的飞行，我们终于到达了伦敦。
quiz.en: After a ten-hour flight, we finally arrived in London.

example.zh: 这里的冬天较冷，记得多带件衣服。
example.en: Winters here are relatively cold, so remember to bring extra clothes.

quiz.zh: 这家店的东西价格较高，但质量很好。
quiz.en: Prices at this shop are relatively high, but the quality is very good.

example.zh: 老人们常说，吃亏是福，不要太计较。
example.en: Old people often say that losing out is a blessing, so don't be too petty.

quiz.zh: 一家人身体健康、平平安安，这就是最大的福。
quiz.en: For the whole family to be healthy and safe is the greatest blessing.

族.gloss: ethnic group, race; group of people (suffix)

example.zh: 中国是一个多民族国家，一共有五十六个民族。
example.en: China is a multi-ethnic country with fifty-six ethnic groups in total.

quiz.zh: 现在很多年轻人成了“上班族”，每天早出晚归。
quiz.en: Nowadays many young people have become office workers, leaving early and coming home late every day.

example.zh: 这辆车是全新的，才开了一百公里。
example.en: This car is brand new; it's only done a hundred kilometres.

quiz.zh: 搬到国外以后，他开始了全新的生活。
quiz.en: After moving abroad, he started a completely new life.

地下.indonesian: bawah tanah; ruang bawah tanah; rahasia

example.zh: 这栋楼有一个很大的地下停车场。
example.en: This building has a big underground car park.

quiz.zh: 这个地区的地下水资源非常丰富。
quiz.en: This area is very rich in groundwater resources.

example.zh: 酒后开车是违法的，被抓到会受到严厉的处罚。
example.en: Drink-driving is against the law, and if you're caught you'll be severely punished.

quiz.zh: 他因为违法经营，被罚了五万元。
quiz.en: He was fined fifty thousand yuan for running his business illegally.

长期.gloss: long-term; a long period of time

example.zh: 长期熬夜对身体很不好，你还是早点睡吧。
example.en: Staying up late over a long period is very bad for you; you'd better go to bed early.

quiz.zh: 我们希望和贵公司建立长期的合作关系。
quiz.en: We hope to establish a long-term partnership with your company.

品.gloss: suffix for goods or products (as in product, work of art); quality, character; to taste
品.indonesian: akhiran untuk barang atau produk (seperti produk, karya); mutu, watak; mencicipi

example.zh: 这些都是我们公司今年推出的新产品。
example.en: These are all new products our company launched this year.

quiz.zh: 这位画家的作品在国内外都很有名。
quiz.en: This painter's works are famous both at home and abroad.

example.zh: 我从小就喜欢收集邮票，现在已经有好几千张了。
example.en: I've loved collecting stamps since I was little and now have several thousand.

quiz.zh: 警方正在收集证据，争取早日破案。
quiz.en: The police are gathering evidence, hoping to crack the case soon.

深入.gloss: to go deep into; deep, thorough, in-depth

example.zh: 记者深入农村，了解农民的真实生活。
example.en: The reporters went deep into the countryside to learn about farmers' real lives.

quiz.zh: 这个问题我们需要更深入地研究一下。
quiz.en: We need to study this problem in more depth.

example.zh: 这首诗表达了作者对家乡深深的情感。
example.en: This poem expresses the author's deep feelings for his hometown.

quiz.zh: 他是个不善于表达情感的人，很少说“我爱你”。
quiz.en: He's not good at expressing his emotions and rarely says "I love you".

称为.gloss: to be called, to be known as

example.zh: 熊猫数量很少，被称为中国的国宝。
example.en: Pandas are very few in number and are known as China's national treasure.

quiz.zh: 这座城市因为桥多，被人们称为“桥城”。
quiz.en: Because it has so many bridges, people call this city "the City of Bridges".

example.zh: 节假日期间，高速公路上的车辆特别多。
example.en: During holidays, there are especially many vehicles on the expressways.

quiz.zh: 这条路正在维修，禁止车辆通行。
quiz.en: This road is under repair and closed to vehicles.

当年.gloss: that year; in those days, back then
当年.indonesian: tahun itu; dulu, pada masa itu

example.zh: 爷爷常常给我们讲他当年当兵的故事。
example.en: Grandpa often tells us stories about his days in the army.

quiz.zh: 他还是当年那个样子，一点都没变。
quiz.en: He looks just the way he did back then; he hasn't changed a bit.

使得.gloss: to cause, to make, to result in

example.zh: 连续几天的大雨使得河水猛涨。
example.en: Several days of heavy rain caused the river to rise sharply.

quiz.zh: 网购的发展使得人们的生活更加方便。
quiz.en: The growth of online shopping has made people's lives more convenient.

example.zh: 他在人群中一眼就认出了自己的女儿。
example.en: He spotted his daughter in the crowd at a glance.

quiz.zh: 一听说明星来了，人群一下子涌了过来。
quiz.en: As soon as they heard the star had arrived, the crowd surged forward.

产.gloss: to produce, to yield; to give birth

example.zh: 这个地方盛产苹果，秋天到处都是果香。
example.en: This place is famous for its apples; in autumn the scent of fruit is everywhere.

quiz.zh: 这种茶叶产自云南，味道很特别。
quiz.en: This tea comes from Yunnan and has a very special flavour.

争.gloss: to compete for, to fight over; to argue

example.zh: 两个孩子为了一个玩具争了起来。
example.en: The two children started fighting over a toy.

quiz.zh: 这两支球队正在争冠军，比赛非常激烈。
quiz.en: These two teams are fighting for the championship, and the match is very intense.

example.zh: 请帮我把这张桌子往左移一点。
example.en: Please help me move this table a little to the left.

quiz.zh: 他的目光一直没有从那幅画上移开。
quiz.en: His eyes never left that painting.

测.gloss: to measure, to test; to predict

example.zh: 护士给我测了体温，三十七度五。
example.en: The nurse took my temperature: 37.5 degrees.

quiz.zh: 你去医院测一下血压吧，最近你总说头晕。
quiz.en: Go to the hospital and get your blood pressure checked; you keep saying you feel dizzy lately.

example.zh: 天气越来越热了，我想把头发剪短一点。
example.en: It's getting hotter and hotter, so I want to have my hair cut a bit shorter.

quiz.zh: 他把报纸上那篇文章剪下来贴在了本子上。
quiz.en: He cut that article out of the newspaper and stuck it in his notebook.

example.zh: 列车马上就要到站了，请保管好自己的随身物品。
example.en: The train is about to arrive at the station; please keep your personal belongings with you.

quiz.zh: 机场规定，危险物品不能带上飞机。
quiz.en: Airport rules say dangerous items can't be taken on the plane.

example.zh: 他的伤口一直流血，怎么也止不住。
example.en: His wound kept bleeding and nothing could stop it.

quiz.zh: 这种药可以止痛，但不能多吃。
quiz.en: This medicine can stop pain, but you shouldn't take too much.

example.zh: 小区门口的保安每天都检查进出的车辆。
example.en: The security guards at the entrance of the residential complex check vehicles coming in and out every day.

quiz.zh: 他在一家银行当保安，晚上要值班。
quiz.en: He works as a security guard at a bank and has to do night shifts.

example.zh: 她每天在实验室里工作十几个小时。
example.en: She works more than ten hours a day in the lab.

quiz.zh: 实验室里有很多危险的化学品，不能随便进。
quiz.en: There are many dangerous chemicals in the lab, so you can't just go in.

example.zh: 全体员工都参加了这次活动。
example.en: All the staff took part in this event.

quiz.zh: 请全体同学起立，向老师问好。
quiz.en: All students, please stand up and greet the teacher.

挤.gloss: to squeeze, to push, to crowd; crowded

example.zh: 早上的地铁太挤了，我差点上不去。
example.en: The subway in the morning is so crowded I almost couldn't get on.

quiz.zh: 电影票今天打折，售票处门口挤满了人。
quiz.en: Movie tickets are discounted today, and the ticket office entrance is packed with people.

example.zh: 她大学学的是医学，现在是一名儿科医生。
example.en: She studied medicine at university and is now a paediatrician.

quiz.zh: 随着医学的发展，很多以前治不好的病现在都能治了。
quiz.en: With the development of medicine, many diseases that used to be incurable can now be treated.

example.zh: 经过认真考虑，他作出了辞职的决定。
example.en: After careful thought, he made the decision to resign.

quiz.zh: 他为公司的发展作出了很大的贡献。
quiz.en: He made a great contribution to the company's development.

example.zh: 我最喜欢吃妈妈炸的鸡翅，又香又脆。
example.en: My favourite thing is the chicken wings my mum fries: fragrant and crispy.

quiz.zh: 油炸食品吃多了对身体不好。
quiz.en: Eating too much deep-fried food is bad for you.

example.zh: 专家预测，明年房价还会继续上涨。
example.en: Experts predict that house prices will keep rising next year.

quiz.zh: 未来会怎么样，谁也无法准确预测。
quiz.en: No one can accurately predict what the future will be like.

静.gloss: quiet, still, calm; to calm down

example.zh: 夜深了，街上静得一点声音都没有。
example.en: It's late at night and the street is so quiet there isn't a sound.

quiz.zh: 你先静下心来，想想问题到底出在哪儿。
quiz.en: Calm down first and think about where the problem actually lies.

谈话.gloss: to talk, to have a conversation; conversation

example.zh: 经理找他谈话，问他最近工作怎么样。
example.en: The manager called him in for a talk and asked how his work had been going.

quiz.zh: 两位领导的谈话持续了一个多小时。
quiz.en: The two leaders' conversation lasted more than an hour.

打破.gloss: to break, to smash; to break (a record, silence)

example.zh: 他在比赛中打破了世界纪录。
example.en: He broke the world record in the competition.

quiz.zh: 一阵电话铃声打破了房间里的安静。
quiz.en: The ring of a telephone broke the silence in the room.

全力.gloss: full strength, all-out effort; with all one's might

example.zh: 我们会尽全力完成这项任务。
example.en: We will do our utmost to complete this task.

quiz.zh: 运动员们正在全力准备下个月的比赛。
quiz.en: The athletes are going all out to prepare for next month's competition.

签名.gloss: to sign one's name; signature, autograph

example.zh: 如果没有问题，请在合同的最后一页签名。
example.en: If everything is in order, please sign on the last page of the contract.

quiz.zh: 演出结束后，很多粉丝排队找歌手要签名。
quiz.en: After the show, many fans queued up to ask the singer for an autograph.

example.zh: 请你描述一下那个人长什么样。
example.en: Please describe what that person looks like.

quiz.zh: 那里的风景美得无法用语言描述。
quiz.en: The scenery there is so beautiful it can't be described in words.

example.zh: 本店今日休息，明日正常营业。
example.en: This shop is closed today and will open as usual tomorrow.

quiz.zh: 今日起，这条地铁线路将延长运营时间。
quiz.en: Starting today, this subway line will extend its operating hours.

认.gloss: to recognize, to know; to admit

example.zh: 多年不见，我差点没认出他来。
example.en: I hadn't seen him for years and almost didn't recognize him.

quiz.zh: 这孩子才三岁，已经认了好几百个字。
quiz.en: This child is only three and already knows several hundred characters.

在场.gloss: to be present, to be on the scene

example.zh: 事故发生时，他正好在场，看到了整个过程。
example.en: He happened to be there when the accident occurred and saw the whole thing.

quiz.zh: 在场的人都被他的话感动了。
quiz.en: Everyone present was moved by what he said.

含.gloss: to contain; to hold in the mouth

example.zh: 这种饮料含大量的糖，最好少喝。
example.en: This drink contains a lot of sugar, so it's best to drink less of it.

quiz.zh: 他嘴里含着一块糖，说话不太清楚。
quiz.en: He had a sweet in his mouth, so he wasn't speaking very clearly.

采用.gloss: to adopt, to use, to employ

example.zh: 这座大楼采用了最新的环保技术。
example.en: This building uses the latest green technology.

quiz.zh: 公司最后采用了小王提出的方案。
quiz.en: In the end the company adopted the plan Xiao Wang proposed.

提升.gloss: to promote (in rank); to raise, to improve

example.zh: 他工作努力，很快就被提升为部门经理。
example.en: He worked hard and was soon promoted to department manager.

quiz.zh: 多读书可以提升一个人的文化水平。
quiz.en: Reading more can raise a person's level of education and culture.

地面.gloss: ground, floor; surface of the earth

example.zh: 下了一夜的雪，早上起来一看，地面全白了。
example.en: It snowed all night; when I got up in the morning, the ground was completely white.

quiz.zh: 飞机已经离开地面，慢慢飞上了天空。
quiz.en: The plane has left the ground and is slowly climbing into the sky.

无关.gloss: to have nothing to do with, to be unrelated

example.zh: 这件事跟你无关，你就别管了。
example.en: This has nothing to do with you, so stay out of it.

quiz.zh: 成功与年龄无关，关键是要肯努力。
quiz.en: Success has nothing to do with age; what matters is being willing to work hard.

靠近.gloss: to approach, to get close to; near

example.zh: 风停了，小船慢慢靠近了岸边。
example.en: The wind dropped, and the little boat slowly drew close to the shore.

quiz.zh: 我想找一个靠近地铁站的房子。
quiz.en: I'd like to find a place near a subway station.

example.zh: 犯了错误不要紧，但应当勇敢地承认。
example.en: Making a mistake is fine, but you should have the courage to admit it.

quiz.zh: 年轻人应当多出去走走，看看外面的世界。
quiz.en: Young people ought to get out more and see the world.

罚.gloss: to punish, to penalize; to fine

example.zh: 他因为闯红灯被罚了两百块钱。
example.en: He was fined two hundred yuan for running a red light.

quiz.zh: 上课迟到的学生要被老师罚站。
quiz.en: Students who are late for class are made to stand as punishment.

空中.gloss: in the air, in the sky; aerial

example.zh: 天气晴朗，鸟儿在空中自由地飞翔。
example.en: The weather is clear, and birds are flying freely in the sky.

quiz.zh: 新年夜里，五颜六色的烟花在空中绽开。
quiz.en: On New Year's night, colourful fireworks burst open in the sky.

连接.gloss: to connect, to link, to join

example.zh: 这座大桥连接了两座城市，开车只要二十分钟。
example.en: This bridge connects two cities; the drive takes only twenty minutes.

quiz.zh: 要上网的话，请先把电脑连接到无线网络上。
quiz.en: If you want to go online, please connect the computer to the wireless network first.

example.zh: 这家药店的药品种类很多，价格也比较便宜。
example.en: This pharmacy stocks a wide range of medicines, and the prices are fairly low.

quiz.zh: 药品应当放在孩子拿不到的地方。
quiz.en: Medicines should be kept out of children's reach.

example.zh: 这部影片讲述了一个感人的故事。
example.en: This film tells a moving story.

quiz.zh: 这是一部根据真实事件改编的影片。
quiz.en: This is a film adapted from real events.

此时.gloss: at this moment, at this time, now

example.zh: 此时此刻，我的心情非常激动。
example.en: At this very moment, I feel extremely excited.

quiz.zh: 他正准备出门，此时电话突然响了。
quiz.en: He was just about to go out when the phone suddenly rang.

当作.gloss: to treat as, to regard as, to use as

example.zh: 他把我当作亲弟弟一样照顾。
example.en: He looks after me as if I were his own little brother.

quiz.zh: 你就把这里当作自己的家，别客气。
quiz.en: Just treat this place as your own home; make yourself comfortable.

example.zh: 听到这个好消息，她激动得流下了眼泪。
example.en: Hearing the good news, she was so moved that she shed tears.

quiz.zh: 孩子擦干眼泪，又高高兴兴地去玩了。
quiz.en: The child wiped away his tears and went off happily to play again.

example.zh: 电影中的画面非常美，像一幅幅风景画。
example.en: The images in the film are beautiful, like a series of landscape paintings.

quiz.zh: 那天离别的画面，我到现在还记得清清楚楚。
quiz.en: I still remember the scene of our parting that day very clearly.

隔.gloss: to separate, to partition; to be apart (by distance or time)

example.zh: 我们两家只隔着一条马路，经常互相串门。
example.en: Our two families live just across the road from each other and often drop by.

quiz.zh: 两个房间之间只隔了一面薄墙，说话都能听见。
quiz.en: Only a thin wall separates the two rooms, so you can hear people talking.

example.zh: 这家饭馆做的都是本地的特色菜。
example.en: This restaurant serves only local specialities.

quiz.zh: 他不是本地人，说话带着外地口音。
quiz.en: He's not from around here; he speaks with an accent from elsewhere.

example.zh: 适当的运动对大脑很有好处。
example.en: Moderate exercise is very good for the brain.

quiz.zh: 他太累了，大脑一片空白，什么也想不起来。
quiz.en: He was so tired his mind went blank and he couldn't remember anything.

example.zh: 我们要从自身找原因，不要总怪别人。
example.en: We should look for the cause in ourselves and not always blame others.

quiz.zh: 每个人都应该根据自身的情况选择合适的工作。
quiz.en: Everyone should choose a suitable job based on their own situation.

example.zh: 结婚是人生中的一件大事，一定要慎重考虑。
example.en: Getting married is a major event in life, so think it over carefully.

quiz.zh: 出什么大事了？你怎么这么着急？
quiz.en: What's happened? Why are you in such a hurry?

example.zh: 你们先走吧，我把东西收拾好随后就到。
example.en: You go ahead; I'll pack up my things and follow right after.

quiz.zh: 警察接到报警后立刻赶到现场，救护车随后也到了。
quiz.en: The police rushed to the scene as soon as they got the call, and an ambulance arrived soon after.

example.zh: 我的手机系统该升级了，运行越来越慢。
example.en: My phone's system needs upgrading; it's running slower and slower.

quiz.zh: 这家酒店把我们的房间免费升级成了套房。
quiz.en: The hotel upgraded our room to a suite for free.

example.zh: 汽车开始加速，很快就超过了前面的卡车。
example.en: The car began to speed up and soon overtook the lorry in front.

quiz.zh: 政府出台新政策，加速推动新能源汽车的发展。
quiz.en: The government has introduced new policies to accelerate the development of new-energy vehicles.

example.zh: 水对人体非常重要，每天都要多喝水。
example.en: Water is very important to the human body, so drink plenty every day.

quiz.zh: 吸烟对人体的危害很大，最好早点戒掉。
quiz.en: Smoking does great harm to the human body; it's best to quit as early as you can.

example.zh: 她第一次独自出国旅行，心里有点紧张。
example.en: It was her first time travelling abroad alone, and she was a bit nervous.

quiz.zh: 天黑以后，女孩子最好不要独自走夜路。
quiz.en: After dark, it's best for girls not to walk alone at night.

推进.gloss: to push forward, to advance, to promote

example.zh: 在大家的努力下，这个项目正在顺利推进。
example.en: Thanks to everyone's efforts, the project is moving forward smoothly.

quiz.zh: 两国政府决定共同推进经济合作。
quiz.en: The two governments decided to jointly advance economic cooperation.

example.zh: 我在网上搜了一下，找到了那家店的地址。
example.en: I did a quick search online and found that shop's address.

quiz.zh: 警察把他的房间搜了一遍，什么也没找到。
quiz.en: The police searched his room and found nothing.

大众.gloss: the masses, the public, the general public

example.zh: 这种手机价格便宜，很受大众欢迎。
example.en: This phone is cheap and very popular with the public.

quiz.zh: 这部电影内容简单易懂，适合大众观看。
quiz.en: This film is simple and easy to understand, suitable for a general audience.

example.zh: 他在大学学的是计算机专业。
example.en: He majored in computer science at university.

quiz.zh: 现在很多工作都离不开计算机。
quiz.en: Many jobs today can't be done without computers.

example.zh: 这次地震中有很多房屋倒塌了，不少人无家可归。
example.en: Many houses collapsed in the earthquake, and many people were left homeless.

quiz.zh: 这一带的房屋大多是上世纪八十年代建的。
quiz.en: Most of the houses in this area were built in the 1980s.

example.zh: 他在城里做服装买卖，生意还不错。
example.en: He runs a clothing business in town, and it's doing quite well.

quiz.zh: 这笔买卖我们亏了不少钱，以后得小心点。
quiz.en: We lost quite a lot of money on this deal; we'll have to be more careful from now on.

出售.gloss: to sell, to offer for sale

example.zh: 这套房子正在出售，有兴趣可以来看看。
example.en: This flat is for sale; come and take a look if you're interested.

quiz.zh: 法律规定，商店不得向未成年人出售烟酒。
quiz.en: By law, shops may not sell cigarettes or alcohol to minors.

example.zh: 这家公司的总部设在北京，在上海有分公司。
example.en: This company's headquarters is in Beijing, and it has a branch in Shanghai.

quiz.zh: 他被调到总部工作，所以要搬家了。
quiz.en: He's been transferred to head office, so he has to move.

分离.gloss: to separate, to part, to be apart

example.zh: 那场战争使很多家庭被迫分离，几十年都没见过面。
example.en: That war forced many families apart; they didn't see each other for decades.

quiz.zh: 和父母分离了二十年，他终于回到了家乡。
quiz.en: After twenty years apart from his parents, he finally returned home.

扇.gloss: to fan; fan; measure word for doors and windows
扇.indonesian: mengipas; kipas; kata penggolong untuk pintu dan jendela

example.zh: 天太热了，奶奶拿着扇子不停地扇风。
example.en: It was so hot that Grandma kept fanning herself with a fan.

quiz.zh: 他热得满头大汗，拿起一本杂志不停地扇着。
quiz.en: He was so hot he was dripping with sweat, so he picked up a magazine and kept fanning himself.

堵.gloss: to block, to clog, to stop up; blocked, congested; measure word for walls
堵.indonesian: menyumbat, menghalangi; macet, tersumbat; kata penggolong untuk tembok

example.zh: 下班时间路上特别堵，开车要一个多小时。
example.en: The roads are really jammed at rush hour; driving takes over an hour.

quiz.zh: 厨房的水管堵了，得找人来修。
quiz.en: The kitchen pipe is blocked; we need to get someone to fix it.

预计.gloss: to estimate, to expect, to forecast

example.zh: 气象台预计，明天本市会有大到暴雨。
example.en: The weather bureau expects heavy to torrential rain in the city tomorrow.

quiz.zh: 这座大桥预计明年年底建成通车。
quiz.en: This bridge is expected to be completed and open to traffic by the end of next year.

当成.gloss: to take as, to mistake for; to treat as

example.zh: 我说的都是为你好，别把我的话当成耳边风。
example.en: I'm only saying this for your own good, so don't let my words go in one ear and out the other.

quiz.zh: 他一直把这只狗当成自己的家人。
quiz.en: He has always treated this dog as one of the family.

example.zh: 工作之余，适当运动有益健康。
example.en: Doing a suitable amount of exercise outside work is good for your health.

quiz.zh: 请你根据实际情况，适当调整一下计划。
quiz.en: Please adjust the plan as appropriate to the actual situation.

example.zh: 这里的景色如同一幅美丽的画。
example.en: The scenery here is like a beautiful painting.

quiz.zh: 他对待学生如同对待自己的孩子一样。
quiz.en: He treats his students as he would his own children.

提起.gloss: to mention, to bring up, to speak of

example.zh: 一提起他的女儿，他就很骄傲。
example.en: Whenever his daughter is mentioned, he gets very proud.

quiz.zh: 这件事你千万别在他面前提起。
quiz.en: Whatever you do, don't bring this up in front of him.

example.zh: 这座大桥是十年前建造的，当时花了很多钱。
example.en: This bridge was built ten years ago and cost a lot of money at the time.

quiz.zh: 政府计划在这里建造一座新的体育馆。
quiz.en: The government plans to build a new stadium here.

example.zh: 中秋节的时候，大家都要吃月饼。
example.en: At the Mid-Autumn Festival, everyone eats mooncakes.

quiz.zh: 早上我常在路边买一个鸡蛋饼当早饭。
quiz.en: In the morning I often buy an egg pancake by the roadside for breakfast.

example.zh: 她大学毕业后，在电视台当新闻主持人。
example.en: After graduating from university, she became a news presenter at a TV station.

quiz.zh: 这场比赛将由中央电视台现场直播。
quiz.en: This match will be broadcast live by China Central Television.

example.zh: 他的腰部感到一阵剧烈的疼痛。
example.en: He felt a sharp pain in his lower back.

quiz.zh: 吃了止痛药以后，他的疼痛减轻了不少。
quiz.en: After taking painkillers, his pain eased quite a bit.

example.zh: 由于天气原因，飞机不得不返回机场。
example.en: Because of the weather, the plane had to return to the airport.

quiz.zh: 春节过后，很多人陆续返回城市工作。
quiz.en: After the Spring Festival, many people gradually return to the cities to work.

example.zh: 情人节那天，他送给女朋友一束红玫瑰。
example.en: On Valentine's Day, he gave his girlfriend a bouquet of red roses.

quiz.zh: 花园里的玫瑰开得正好，香气扑鼻。
quiz.en: The roses in the garden are in full bloom, and their scent is wonderful.

富有.gloss: rich, wealthy; to be full of, to possess

example.zh: 他虽然很富有，但生活很简朴。
example.en: Although he's very wealthy, he lives very simply.

quiz.zh: 这位老师讲课生动，富有激情。
quiz.en: This teacher's lessons are lively and full of passion.

example.zh: 这个人人脉很广，在哪儿都能找到朋友帮忙。
example.en: This person has a wide network and can find friends to help wherever he goes.

quiz.zh: 这本书涉及的内容很广，从历史到科学都有。
quiz.en: This book covers a broad range of topics, from history to science.

example.zh: 这条公交线路经过市中心，坐的人特别多。
example.en: This bus route goes through the city centre, so lots of people take it.

quiz.zh: 由于线路故障，地铁暂停运营半小时。
quiz.en: Because of a line fault, the subway was suspended for half an hour.

example.zh: 这个箱子太沉了，我一个人搬不动。
example.en: This box is too heavy; I can't move it on my own.

quiz.zh: 那艘船遇到暴风雨，很快就沉到了海底。
quiz.en: The ship ran into a storm and soon sank to the bottom of the sea.

example.zh: 退休后，他搬到乡村去住了，每天种种菜、养养花。
example.en: After retiring, he moved to the countryside, where he grows vegetables and flowers every day.

quiz.zh: 很多城里人周末喜欢到乡村去过几天安静的日子。
quiz.en: Many city people like to go to the countryside at weekends for a few quiet days.

伙.gloss: measure word for groups or bands of people; group, partner
伙.indonesian: kata penggolong untuk kelompok orang; kelompok, rekan

example.zh: 一伙小偷在火车站被警察抓住了。
example.en: A gang of thieves was caught by the police at the train station.

quiz.zh: 门口站着一伙年轻人，有说有笑的。
quiz.en: A group of young people were standing at the door, chatting and laughing.

填.gloss: to fill, to fill in (a form)

example.zh: 报名的时候，请用黑色的笔填这张表。
example.en: When you register, please fill in this form with a black pen.

quiz.zh: 他们用土把门前的坑填平了。
quiz.en: They filled in the hole in front of the door with earth.

example.zh: 我和他住在同一个小区，经常一起坐车上班。
example.en: He and I live in the same residential complex and often commute together.

quiz.zh: 两个人在同一天出生，真是太巧了。
quiz.en: The two of them were born on the same day; what a coincidence.

example.zh: 离出发只剩半个小时了，时间有限，大家抓紧。
example.en: There's only half an hour left before we set off; time is limited, so everyone hurry up.

quiz.zh: 这次活动名额有限，请大家尽快报名。
quiz.en: Places for this event are limited, so please sign up as soon as possible.

半夜.gloss: midnight, the middle of the night

example.zh: 半夜里，楼上突然传来一阵吵闹声。
example.en: In the middle of the night, a racket suddenly came from upstairs.

quiz.zh: 他最近项目很忙，经常工作到半夜才回家。
quiz.en: He's been very busy with a project lately and often works until midnight before going home.

example.zh: 这道菜是当地有名的美味，来这里一定要尝尝。
example.en: This dish is a famous local delicacy; you must try it when you come here.

quiz.zh: 桌上摆满了各种美味，大家都吃得很开心。
quiz.en: The table was covered with all kinds of delicious food, and everyone ate happily.

example.zh: 天气不好，对我们的比赛很不利。
example.en: The bad weather is very unfavourable for our match.

quiz.zh: 长时间盯着手机看，对眼睛很不利。
quiz.en: Staring at your phone for a long time is bad for your eyes.

example.zh: 这次考试的难度比上次大多了。
example.en: This exam was much harder than the last one.

quiz.zh: 这个动作难度很高，一般人做不了。
quiz.en: This move is very difficult; ordinary people can't do it.

example.zh: 这条铁路连接了南北两个大城市。
example.en: This railway connects two big cities in the north and south.

quiz.zh: 新的铁路开通以后，从这里到北京只需要三个小时。
quiz.en: Since the new railway opened, it only takes three hours to get from here to Beijing.

example.zh: 他的发言简短而有力，赢得了大家的掌声。
example.en: His speech was short and forceful and won everyone's applause.

quiz.zh: 律师拿出了有力的证据，证明他是无辜的。
quiz.en: The lawyer produced strong evidence proving he was innocent.

约定.gloss: to agree on, to arrange; agreement, appointment

example.zh: 我们约定每年这个时候在这里见面。
example.en: We agreed to meet here at this time every year.

quiz.zh: 别忘了我们之间的约定，十年后再见。
quiz.en: Don't forget our agreement: we'll meet again in ten years.

example.zh: 在这个时代，掌握一门技能很重要。
example.en: In this day and age, it's important to master a skill.

quiz.zh: 公司为新员工提供各种技能培训。
quiz.en: The company provides new employees with all kinds of skills training.

example.zh: 他是一位知名的作家，写过很多畅销书。
example.en: He's a well-known writer who has written many bestsellers.

quiz.zh: 她毕业后进了一家知名企业工作。
quiz.en: After graduating, she went to work for a well-known company.

example.zh: 他从不迟到，每天都是第一个到办公室。
example.en: He's never late; he's the first to arrive at the office every day.

quiz.zh: 我爸爸从不抽烟，也很少喝酒。
quiz.en: My dad never smokes and rarely drinks.

example.zh: 天渐渐黑了，路上的行人也少了。
example.en: It gradually got dark, and there were fewer people on the street.

quiz.zh: 来中国两年，他渐渐习惯了这里的生活。
quiz.en: In his two years in China, he has gradually got used to life here.

增强.gloss: to strengthen, to enhance, to increase

example.zh: 经常锻炼可以增强体质，少生病。
example.en: Regular exercise can build up your health so you get ill less often.

quiz.zh: 这次比赛增强了队员们的信心。
quiz.en: This competition boosted the players' confidence.

握.gloss: to hold, to grasp, to grip

example.zh: 他紧紧握住我的手，说了声谢谢。
example.en: He gripped my hand tightly and said thank you.

quiz.zh: 她手里握着一张旧照片，半天没说话。
quiz.en: She held an old photo in her hand and didn't say anything for a long time.

example.zh: 去年他在一场车祸中受了重伤，住了三个月医院。
example.en: Last year he was seriously injured in a car accident and spent three months in hospital.

quiz.zh: 开车时打电话很容易引起车祸。
quiz.en: Talking on the phone while driving can easily cause an accident.

整整.gloss: whole, full, fully (an entire amount of time, etc.)

example.zh: 你怎么现在才来？我整整等了你两个小时！
example.en: Why are you only getting here now? I waited for you for two whole hours!

quiz.zh: 为了准备这次考试，他整整一个月没出门。
quiz.en: To prepare for this exam, he didn't leave the house for a whole month.

example.zh: 抽烟是一种不良习惯，对自己和家人都不好。
example.en: Smoking is a bad habit that's harmful to both you and your family.

quiz.zh: 这个网站上有很多不良信息，不适合孩子看。
quiz.en: This website has a lot of harmful content that isn't suitable for children.

example.zh: 年轻人有着无限的可能，不要轻易放弃梦想。
example.en: Young people have endless possibilities; don't give up your dreams lightly.

quiz.zh: 这张卡可以在一个月内无限次乘坐地铁。
quiz.en: This card lets you ride the subway an unlimited number of times in a month.

example.zh: 他待人真诚，大家都愿意和他交朋友。
example.en: He treats people sincerely, so everyone wants to be his friend.

quiz.zh: 那天是我说话太冲了，我真诚地希望你能原谅我。
quiz.en: I spoke too harshly that day; I sincerely hope you can forgive me.

前来.gloss: to come, to come forward (to a place)

example.zh: 感谢各位前来参加今天的活动。
example.en: Thank you all for coming to today's event.

quiz.zh: 听说他病了，很多老朋友都前来看望他。
quiz.en: On hearing he was ill, many old friends came to visit him.

example.zh: 很多年轻人通过网络平台卖自己做的东西。
example.en: Many young people sell things they make through online platforms.

quiz.zh: 这次比赛为年轻歌手提供了一个展示自己的平台。
quiz.en: This competition gave young singers a platform to show what they can do.

example.zh: 有什么想法就大胆说出来，不要害怕说错。
example.en: If you have any ideas, speak up boldly; don't be afraid of saying something wrong.

quiz.zh: 这个设计非常大胆，用了很多鲜艳的颜色。
quiz.en: This design is very bold and uses lots of bright colours.

example.zh: 宝宝张开嘴巴，等着妈妈喂饭。
example.en: The baby opened its mouth, waiting for Mum to feed it.

quiz.zh: 吃完饭记得用纸巾把嘴巴擦干净。
quiz.en: Remember to wipe your mouth with a napkin after eating.

留言.gloss: to leave a message; message, comment

example.zh: 他不在家，我就在微信上给他留言了。
example.en: He wasn't home, so I left him a message on WeChat.

quiz.zh: 这篇文章下面有很多读者的留言。
quiz.en: There are lots of readers' comments under this article.

example.zh: 这个城市有众多的名胜古迹。
example.en: This city has numerous scenic spots and historic sites.

quiz.zh: 他在众多应聘者中脱颖而出，得到了这份工作。
quiz.en: He stood out from the many applicants and got the job.

example.zh: 这种食品的糖含量很高，糖尿病人不能吃。
example.en: This food has a high sugar content, so diabetics can't eat it.

quiz.zh: 这种水果的维生素C含量很高，多吃对皮肤好。
quiz.en: This fruit is high in vitamin C, so eating more of it is good for your skin.

开通.gloss: to open (a service or line), to activate

example.zh: 这条地铁线路将于下个月正式开通。
example.en: This subway line will officially open next month.

quiz.zh: 我已经开通了手机银行，转账很方便。
quiz.en: I've activated mobile banking, so transferring money is very convenient.

增.gloss: to increase, to add, to grow

example.zh: 今年来这里旅游的人数比去年增了一倍。
example.en: The number of tourists here this year has doubled compared to last year.

quiz.zh: 这两年，这个城市的人口猛增，房子越来越难租了。
quiz.en: The city's population has surged in the past two years, and flats are getting harder and harder to rent.

四处.gloss: all around, everywhere, in all directions

example.zh: 他四处打听，终于找到了那家老店。
example.en: He asked around everywhere and finally found that old shop.

quiz.zh: 我的钥匙不见了，四处都找遍了也没找到。
quiz.en: My keys are gone; I've looked everywhere and can't find them.

病情.gloss: patient's condition, state of an illness

example.zh: 经过治疗，他的病情已经稳定了。
example.en: After treatment, his condition has stabilized.

quiz.zh: 医生说老人的病情很严重，需要马上手术。
quiz.en: The doctor said the old man's condition is serious and he needs surgery immediately.

挑选.gloss: to select, to choose, to pick out

example.zh: 她在商店里挑选了半天，最后买了一条红裙子。
example.en: She spent ages choosing in the shop and finally bought a red skirt.

quiz.zh: 公司从一百多人中挑选出五位参加比赛。
quiz.en: The company selected five people out of more than a hundred to take part in the competition.

example.zh: 春节是和亲人团聚的日子，大家都想回家过年。
example.en: The Spring Festival is a time to reunite with family, and everyone wants to go home for the New Year.

quiz.zh: 他在这座城市没有一个亲人，只能靠自己。
quiz.en: He doesn't have a single relative in this city and has to rely on himself.

example.zh: 等我们到的时候，电影早已开始了。
example.en: By the time we arrived, the film had long since started.

quiz.zh: 这件事我早已忘得一干二净了。
quiz.en: I forgot all about that long ago.

example.zh: 充足的睡眠对健康很重要，成年人每天最好睡七八个小时。
example.en: Getting enough sleep is very important for health; adults should ideally sleep seven or eight hours a day.

quiz.zh: 最近工作压力大，他的睡眠质量很差。
quiz.en: Work has been stressful lately, and he's been sleeping badly.

example.zh: 晚上城市里灯光闪闪，非常漂亮。
example.en: At night the city's lights twinkle; it's beautiful.

quiz.zh: 房间里的灯光太暗了，看书对眼睛不好。
quiz.en: The light in the room is too dim; reading in it is bad for your eyes.

example.zh: 这张优惠券已经过期了，现在使用无效。
example.en: This coupon has expired and is no longer valid.

quiz.zh: 医生用了很多办法，可是治疗都无效。
quiz.en: The doctors tried many methods, but none of the treatments worked.

哎呀.gloss: oh my! ah! (expressing surprise, regret or complaint)

example.zh: 哎呀，我出门的时候忘带钥匙了！
example.en: Oh no, I forgot my keys when I went out!

quiz.zh: 哎呀，都八点了，我上班要迟到了！
quiz.en: Oh my, it's already eight; I'm going to be late for work!

example.zh: 公司今年招了二十多个新人。
example.en: The company has hired more than twenty newcomers this year.

quiz.zh: 我是新人，很多事情还不太懂，请大家多指教。
quiz.en: I'm new here and don't know much yet, so I hope everyone will give me pointers.

刚好.gloss: just right, exactly; as it happens, by chance

example.zh: 这双鞋我穿着刚好，不大也不小。
example.en: These shoes fit me just right, neither too big nor too small.

quiz.zh: 我正想给你打电话，你刚好就来了。
quiz.en: I was just about to call you when you happened to show up.

example.zh: 比赛结束时，比分是三比二，我们赢了。
example.en: When the game ended, the score was 3 to 2; we won.

quiz.zh: 上半场两队的比分一直很接近。
quiz.en: In the first half, the score between the two teams stayed very close.

上下.gloss: up and down; from top to bottom; everyone (high and low)
上下.indonesian: atas dan bawah; dari atas sampai bawah; semua (atasan dan bawahan)

example.zh: 他上下打量了我一番，问我找谁。
example.en: He looked me up and down and asked who I was looking for.

quiz.zh: 全公司上下都在为这次展会做准备。
quiz.en: Everyone in the company, from top to bottom, is preparing for this exhibition.

example.zh: 这家餐厅用机器人给客人送菜。
example.en: This restaurant uses robots to deliver dishes to customers.

quiz.zh: 未来很多简单重复的工作可能会由机器人来完成。
quiz.en: In the future, many simple, repetitive jobs may be done by robots.

距.gloss: to be at a distance from; distance

example.zh: 我家距学校只有五百米，走路几分钟就到。
example.en: My home is only 500 metres from the school; it's a few minutes' walk.

quiz.zh: 距考试还有一个星期，他每天都在复习。
quiz.en: With a week to go before the exam, he's revising every day.

沿.gloss: along; to follow (a road, river); edge

example.zh: 吃完晚饭，我们沿着河边走了很久。
example.en: After dinner, we walked along the river for a long time.

quiz.zh: 沿这条路一直往前走，就能看到那家医院。
quiz.en: Go straight along this road and you'll see the hospital.

脸色.gloss: complexion, colour of the face; facial expression

example.zh: 你脸色不太好，是不是生病了？
example.en: You don't look well. Are you ill?

quiz.zh: 听到这个坏消息，他的脸色一下子变了。
quiz.en: When he heard the bad news, his expression changed at once.

example.zh: 超市里的生活用品种类很多。
example.en: The supermarket has a wide range of household items.

quiz.zh: 开学前，妈妈帮我买齐了各种学习用品。
quiz.en: Before term started, Mum bought me all kinds of school supplies.

example.zh: 这次只是一个小型聚会，来的都是老朋友。
example.en: This is just a small get-together; everyone coming is an old friend.

quiz.zh: 他开了一家小型超市，生意还不错。
quiz.en: He opened a small supermarket, and business is quite good.

好转.gloss: to take a turn for the better, to improve

example.zh: 吃了几天药，他的病情有所好转。
example.en: After a few days of medicine, his condition improved somewhat.

quiz.zh: 今年经济形势开始好转，找工作也容易多了。
quiz.en: This year the economy has started to pick up, and finding a job is much easier.

example.zh: 这种病如果在早期发现，是可以治好的。
example.en: If this disease is found at an early stage, it can be cured.

quiz.zh: 这是这位画家早期的作品，风格和后来很不一样。
quiz.en: This is one of the painter's early works; the style is very different from his later ones.

讲述.gloss: to tell, to narrate, to give an account of

example.zh: 这本书讲述了一个普通家庭的故事。
example.en: This book tells the story of an ordinary family.

quiz.zh: 老人向我们讲述了他年轻时的经历。
quiz.en: The old man told us about his experiences when he was young.

损害.gloss: to damage, to harm, to impair

example.zh: 长期熬夜会损害身体健康，一定要注意休息。
example.en: Staying up late for long periods damages your health, so make sure you get enough rest.

quiz.zh: 这种做法损害了消费者的利益。
quiz.en: This practice harms consumers' interests.

赔.gloss: to compensate, to pay for (damage); to lose money

example.zh: 你把我的手机摔坏了，得赔我一个新的。
example.en: You broke my phone, so you have to replace it with a new one.

quiz.zh: 酒店把客人的行李弄丢了，只好赔了两千块。
quiz.en: The hotel lost a guest's luggage and had to pay two thousand yuan in compensation.

example.zh: 他是一位成功的商人，在全国开了几十家店。
example.en: He's a successful businessman who has opened dozens of shops around the country.

quiz.zh: 古代很多商人沿着丝绸之路做生意。
quiz.en: In ancient times, many merchants traded along the Silk Road.

example.zh: 糟了，我把护照忘在酒店了，飞机马上就要起飞了！
example.en: Oh no, I left my passport at the hotel, and the plane is about to take off!

quiz.zh: 他的成绩越来越糟，父母很着急。
quiz.en: His grades are getting worse and worse, and his parents are very worried.

example.zh: 他是一位研究中国历史的著名学者。
example.en: He's a famous scholar of Chinese history.

quiz.zh: 会议邀请了来自国内外的专家学者。
quiz.en: The conference invited experts and scholars from home and abroad.

四周.gloss: all around, on all sides, surroundings

example.zh: 房子四周都是树，非常安静，很适合养老。
example.en: The house is surrounded by trees and is very quiet, perfect for retirement.

quiz.zh: 他向四周看了看，发现没有人，才小声说了出来。
quiz.en: He looked around, saw that no one was there, and only then said it quietly.

example.zh: 包括我在内，一共有十个人参加。
example.en: Including me, ten people took part in total.

quiz.zh: 连孩子在内，我们家一共有五口人。
quiz.en: Counting the kids, there are five people in our family.

含有.gloss: to contain, to have (as an ingredient)

example.zh: 牛奶中含有丰富的钙，对骨骼很有好处。
example.en: Milk contains plenty of calcium, which is very good for your bones.

quiz.zh: 这种饮料含有酒精，开车的人不能喝。
quiz.en: This drink contains alcohol, so people who are driving can't have it.

example.zh: 演讲结束后，台下响起了热烈的掌声。
example.en: After the speech, warm applause rang out from the audience.

quiz.zh: 新同学来了，让我们用掌声欢迎她！
quiz.en: Our new classmate is here; let's give her a round of applause!

接收.gloss: to receive (signals, goods); to accept, to take in

example.zh: 这台收音机可以接收到很多国外的电台。
example.en: This radio can pick up many foreign stations.

quiz.zh: 这所学校今年接收了五十多名外国留学生。
quiz.en: This school took in more than fifty international students this year.

推动.gloss: to push forward, to promote, to drive

example.zh: 科技的进步推动了社会的发展。
example.en: Advances in technology have driven social development.

quiz.zh: 政府出台了一系列政策，推动旅游业发展。
quiz.en: The government has introduced a series of policies to boost the tourism industry.

example.zh: 这个方法不一定适用于每个人。
example.en: This method doesn't necessarily work for everyone.

quiz.zh: 这张优惠券只适用于网上购物。
quiz.en: This coupon is only valid for online shopping.

键.gloss: key (on a keyboard or instrument), button

example.zh: 输入密码后，按确认键就可以了。
example.en: After entering the password, just press the confirm button.

quiz.zh: 这台电脑的空格键坏了，打字很不方便。
quiz.en: The space bar on this computer is broken, which makes typing a pain.

example.zh: 退休以后，他一点也闲不住，每天都找事做。
example.en: After retiring, he can't sit idle at all and finds something to do every day.

quiz.zh: 你最近闲吗？有空一起吃个饭吧。
quiz.en: Are you free these days? Let's have a meal together when you have time.

发起.gloss: to initiate, to launch, to start

example.zh: 他发起了一个帮助山区孩子的活动。
example.en: He launched a campaign to help children in mountain areas.

quiz.zh: 这次募捐是由几位大学生发起的。
quiz.en: This fundraiser was started by a few university students.

example.zh: 装修这套房子花费了我们二十多万元。
example.en: Renovating this flat cost us more than two hundred thousand yuan.

quiz.zh: 他花费了整整三年的时间才写完这本书。
quiz.en: It took him three whole years to finish writing this book.

鼓.gloss: drum; to bulge, to swell; to rouse, to encourage; bulging
鼓.indonesian: gendang, drum; menggembung; membangkitkan, mendorong; gembung

example.zh: 舞台上，几个年轻人正在敲鼓，声音非常响。
example.en: On stage, a few young people are beating drums very loudly.

quiz.zh: 他吃得太多，肚子都鼓起来了。
quiz.en: He ate so much that his belly bulged.

example.zh: 来这里旅游的大多是年轻人。
example.en: Most of the tourists who come here are young people.

quiz.zh: 我们班的同学大多来自南方。
quiz.en: Most of the students in our class are from the south.

example.zh: 这首歌的歌词写得很美，像一首诗。
example.en: The lyrics of this song are beautifully written, like a poem.

quiz.zh: 那首老歌我只记得旋律，歌词全忘了。
quiz.en: I only remember the tune of that old song; I've completely forgotten the words.

example.zh: 最近流感很严重，出门最好戴口罩。
example.en: The flu is really bad at the moment, so it's best to wear a mask when you go out.

quiz.zh: 他得了流感，发烧到三十九度。
quiz.en: He caught the flu and has a fever of 39 degrees.

行驶.gloss: to travel, to drive, to run (of a vehicle)

example.zh: 车辆在雨天行驶时，一定要减慢速度。
example.en: Vehicles must slow down when driving in the rain.

quiz.zh: 这列火车以每小时三百公里的速度行驶。
quiz.en: This train travels at three hundred kilometres per hour.

example.zh: 这次旅行的花费超出了我们的预算。
example.en: The cost of this trip went over our budget.

quiz.zh: 这个问题已经超出了我的能力范围。
quiz.en: This problem is beyond my abilities.

example.zh: 夜深了，门外忽然传来一阵脚步声。
example.en: Late at night, the sound of footsteps suddenly came from outside the door.

quiz.zh: 他加快了脚步，想在天黑前赶回家。
quiz.en: He quickened his pace, wanting to get home before dark.

陪伴.gloss: to accompany, to keep someone company; companionship

example.zh: 谢谢你这些年一直陪伴在我身边。
example.en: Thank you for always being by my side all these years.

quiz.zh: 爷爷年纪大了，最需要的是家人的陪伴。
quiz.en: Grandpa is getting old, and what he needs most is his family's company.
